value.rationale: For an entire natural high-symmetry graph family, resolves the full temporal law of a concrete, physically meaningful collision-risk observable under indefinite avoidance, uncovers its exactly universal half-occupancy and computes finite-time path-space information loss relative to the ordinary exclusion dynamics. This is not only an isolated mean or a mechanical parameter change: it gives covariance, integrated uncertainty and two exact entropy rates useful for comparing constrained particle dynamics. Does not claim general-graph extension.
